Generate shell completions for bash.

To enable bash completions for this program add following line to your ~/.bashrc:

    source <(linear completions bash)

Usage: linear completions bash [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -n, --name <command-name>
          The name of the main command.

      --workspace <slug>
          Target workspace (uses credentials)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
